        calc

            rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_range_add_one]
          _ ≤ (m : ℤ) := by
            have h1 : (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n.filter (fun y => x < y), (1 : ℤ)) = (n : ℤ) / 2 := by

  have h2 : (n : ℝ) / 4 ≤ ((n : ℕ) / 4 : ℝ) := by
